digest.component_or_area: rebar-debug skill and plan-review gate documentation
propositions: Step 7 of the rebar-debug skill must declare confirmed bug siblings as acceptance-criteria checkboxes on the bug ticket before proceeding to Phase 2
Siblings must be recorded via set-file-impact and routed through plan-review to trigger the blast-radius escalation, converting the bug from light advisory tier to full blocking-capable rubric
Step 7 should cross-reference the existing Phase-1 exit-gate directive at SKILL.md:562-568 rather than restating it
The rebar command names in Step 7 must be conditioned on tracker type with a generic equivalent stated for portability

docs/plan-review-gate.md currently contradicts the shipped blast-radius escalation by stating bugs are never-blocking; the contradiction must be corrected and the escalation documented as a named subsection under R4
